summary: In Genesis, מַבּוּל names the flood whose rising waters lifted Noah’s ark. Psalm 29 speaks of Yahweh enthroned over the flood.

senses.definition: An inundation in which rising waters cover the land.

evidence.note: The flood lasts forty days, and the waters rise and lift the ark above the earth.
Noah and his family enter the ark because of מֵי הַמַּבּוּל, the waters of the flood.
During the flood the waters increase and lift the ark above the earth.
Yahweh sits enthroned over the flood.
